figures.evidence: All 75 centres of the four panels are within 0.10 of the truth (largest: panel a, Function Call / GPT4-API 68.4 vs 68.3) and all 56 drawn interval ends within 0.08 (panel b, Default - 90% / raw prompt err_lo 44.48 vs 44.4). The only deviation: Candidate 6 and Candidate 2 of panel d, drawn as a dot without a bar (truth err_lo / err_hi null), carry a zero-width interval (48.85-48.85 and 48.3-48.3), which the panel note declares.

All 37 printed Correct shares are exact and correctly labelled (e.g. GPT-4o API 73.7, Llama2-13b-Q5 Local 33.4, Phi3-14b-Q6 Local 48.7), but 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error and Incorrect of all 37 bars are absent: 185 of 222 values, 107 of them non-zero, declared in `uncertain` as 'small' although Incorrect runs from 25.67 to 71.67 and GeminiAdvanced Web has Error 8.67. The one chart is returned as two panels cut at y = 506 inside the Llama block (27 bars, then 10 bars titled '(continued)', following the layout analysis, as the run itself notes), so the scorer pairs only 27 and counts the 10 correct values of the second panel as extra: a structure failure, not wrong numbers.

All 24 printed Correct shares are exact in one correctly placed panel (e.g. GPT4 Web - no image 65.2, GeminiAdvanced Web- direct image 20.3), but the other five series of all 24 bars are absent: 120 of 144 values, 65 of them non-zero, declared in `uncertain` as unlabelled and 'small'. That description does not hold for Incorrect (19.59 to 63.29) nor for the Error segment of 'GeminiAdvanced Web- direct image' (40.47, twice that bar's Correct share).

The x tick labels and axis titles could not be read (black background, the round's known defect; x is ordinal 1-3 and 1-4, not counted against the run), and all 17 printed numbers and all 13 legend names are transcribed correctly, the two labels cut off by the frame as 70.3 and 53.4 (truth 70.35, 53.49). In panel b the run assumed chronological columns where the hidden ticks read 2021-09, 2023-12, 2023-04, 2023-09, and so swapped the sibling models: GPT4-1106 62.35 (truth 65.43), GPT4-0125 65.43 (62.35), GPT3.5-1106 46.30 (48.15), GPT3.5-0125 48.15 (46.30), each at confidence 0.95, with only a general note in `uncertain` that the assignment within a colour family is inferred from legend order; the four values the truth leaves unassigned (babbage / davinci, Instruct / 0613) are committed guesses as well.

Matched by title, all 52 averages are within 1.14 points, 1.6 % of the axis range (largest: panel b at temperature 0.2, 74.14 vs 73.0; mean error 0.19), and the 104 range ends within 1.68 (panel a at 1.4, err_hi 91.68 vs 90.0, under the legend box and declared as uncertain). The record places panel d ('Best Prompt - After Determining Seed') at bbox [5, 365, 321, 491], the lower half of panel c's quadrant, instead of [324, 248, 632, 490], and gives panel c only its upper half [2, 250, 320, 365] (the layout analysis' boxes replaced the reader's own correct ones), which is why the scorer pairs truth c with d's data and reports 21 of 52; the temperatures written as category instead of x ('0', '1', '2' unpaired) are a keying difference, not an error.

All 63 printed cell counts match the truth with rows as category and columns as series (diagonal A-E 16, 25, 24, 13, 4; B/D 1; Parsing Failed 2 and 1 in rows B and C; GPT: Require Evaluation 1, 5, 5, 3 in rows 2OP, EOP, NOP, Error). The three column slices proposed by the layout analysis were merged back into one 9 x 7 heatmap, as the run notes.

summary.assessment: Every number this run returned was read correctly: 268 values over six figures, none further than 1.6 % of the axis range from the truth (S02 bars and intervals within 0.1 point, S06 line points within 1.14, all 63 counts of S08 and all 61 printed Correct shares of S03 and S04 exact), and nothing was invented. Its typical failure is deliberate omission: on both stacked-bar charts it recorded only the series that carries a printed label and declared the other five as too small to estimate, which leaves out 305 of the 573 truth values, among them Incorrect segments of 20 to 72 points and a 40-point Error segment; 'usable' for S03 and S04 therefore means the Correct series only. The second weakness is structural and inherited from the layout analysis: S03 is cut into two panels and S06's panel d carries the box of half of panel c, which makes the automatic scorer undercount correct values (27 of 37 on S03, 21 of 52 on S06). Where the image withholds information it guesses instead of abstaining: on S05, with the tick labels hidden by the round's image defect, it assumed chronological columns and attached four values to the wrong sibling model at confidence 0.95, covered only by a general note. Axis metadata also carries OCR residue (ticks such as '0' and 'Function Call -', a categorical x axis on S03) that does not touch the values. The run can be trusted on charts with printed values and on clean bar, interval and line charts read from geometry; on stacked bars expect the labelled series only, and treat a series attribution that depends on unreadable labels as unverified.
